Cover western flank and southern spot at 10.0E to link fresh south view north to main body while staying south of high winds.
Cover eastern flank edge at 12.2E in lower-wind air to catch crosswind lean east and tie head to main body.

squad_notes.0: Hold SSW head with two lanes sweeping north into southern edge then back south to catch fresh spread.
squad_notes.1: Fly drone 3 north along 10.0E from downwind check to southern spot up through link corridor to western flank then east to main-body gap and back south for revisit, leaving drone 2 to RTB.
squad_notes.2: Push both ships to eastern flank edge near 12.2E for north-south coverage in lower-wind air, with fresh ship covering approach and north tie-in while low-battery ship screens south.

decisions.assessment: Active front spans 10.0-12.2E around 3.9-5.7N with a southern spot near 10.0E, 3.4N. It is running SSW downwind toward 2-3N with slight west drift.

tasks.why: Hold SSW head just south of main body to keep newly burning ground within 30-min view as southern edge pushes from 3.9N toward 2.5N.
Link western lobe at 10.1E,5.2N to southern spot at 10.0E,3.4N while staying in lower-wind southern air.
Cover eastern edge near 12.2E and move low-battery drone south out of ceiling winds into safer air to catch east lean.

squad_notes.0: Hold just south of main body's southern edge patrolling SSW to keep new southward spread within 30-min view.
squad_notes.1: Sweep the gap between western lobe and southern spot staying low-south to keep fresh front in view.
squad_notes.2: Drone 4 pushes northeast to the eastern flank near 12.2E to hold front observation while drone 5 steps south along the flank into lighter winds to keep east-edge coverage.

decisions.assessment: Active front is along southern edge of main cluster near 11.7E,3.9N with western lobe near 10.1E,5.2N and outlier near 10.0E,3.4N. It is heading SSW downwind toward 2-3N in lower-wind southern air while central-north winds exceed ceiling.

tasks.why: Drones low battery swapping/returning hold near base to recover and stay in safe 17.9 m/s air.
Hold SSW head just south of main body 3.9N to keep newly burning ground in view as it pushes toward 2N.
Link western lobe 10.1E,5.2N to southern spot 10.0E,3.4N covering western flank advance in lower winds.

squad_notes.0: Hold both drones near base to conserve battery and stay in safe air while swapping.

squad_notes.2: Sweep the 10.0E corridor from southern spot 3.4N north to western lobe 5.2N with offset east/west tracks to catch flank advance in lower winds.

decisions.assessment: Main active body near 11.8E,5.1N with southern spot at 10.0E,3.4N, both ~28 min since seen. Strong ~20 m/s flow toward 203-210 deg is pushing the head SSW toward 2-3N.

tasks.why: Re-acquire southern edge of large 1500-cell body at 4.1N before window expires and follow SSW head in safe southern winds.
Hold small southern spot at 10.0E,3.4N and track continued SSW run toward 2N.
Link main body to southern spot covering western flank corridor for SW advance and spotting.

squad_notes.0: Re-acquire expiring southern edge and spot fire then sweep SSW head in safer southern winds.
squad_notes.1: Hold 10.0E,3.4N cell before it ages out and sweep parallel SSW tracks downwind toward 2N.
squad_notes.2: Push northeast from base on two parallel tracks into the western flank corridor to link the southern spot to the main-body south edge and watch SSW downwind for advance and spots.

decisions.assessment: Active front unseen for >30 min, last seen near 12-14E, 2-4N. Strong SSW flow toward ~203 deg still driving head south-southwest toward the base line.

tasks.why: Re-acquire last detection in block 12,2 from 32 min ago and follow SSW head toward 12,0 corridor in safe southern winds.
Cover western half of southern front near flying drone at 9.3E,2.1N and block approach to base.
Hold central corridor between start area and southern head to catch flanks and spotovers moving SSW.

squad_notes.0: Sweep north into stale 12,2 block then drift SSW downwind to re-acquire head and map 12,0 corridor with split west/east lanes.
squad_notes.1: Split western half into north and south tiers to track SSW head and block approach to base.
squad_notes.2: Hold central corridor with two northbound lanes to meet SSW-moving flanks head-on.

decisions.assessment: No active burning seen in last 30 min so southern head is lost. Likely front remains south-southwest of reported start drifting SSW toward base corridor with eastern flank unobserved.

tasks.why: Re-sweep southern corridor near current low-battery drones where blocks 10,4 and 12,4 aged 58 min, following SSW drift toward base in safe 20 m/s winds.
Cover western flank approach to base between airborne drone and start, closing gap in coverage blocks 6,2 and 8,4 in flyable southern winds.

squad_notes.2: Climb northeast via lower-wind eastern corridor then split to sweep null blocks west and east of center and map edge around start.

tasks.why: Cover downwind SSW head south of cluster in safe southern winds to catch new ignitions within 30-min window.

Sweep null blocks around reported start in calm northern winds to map burned interior and rule out northern holdover.

squad_notes.0: Sweep two north-to-south transects across the SSW head to catch new spread within 30-min window.

tasks.why: Hold camera on SSW head south of cluster extent to catch new ground within 30-min window in 17-22 m/s flow.

squad_notes.0: Hold SSW head south of active edge with east-west sweeps stepping downwind to catch new ground.
squad_notes.1: Hold SE flank with low-battery drone sweeping SSW along edge while fresh drone from base pushes to SE front to keep new spread in view.
squad_notes.2: Sweep null northern blocks in two west-east lanes to map interior edge and confirm no north spread.

decisions.assessment: Active front runs from [9.0,5.8] east to [12.0,4.7] with southern edge down to y~3.6. Strong 15-23 m/s flow toward ~205 deg will drive the head SSW toward y~2-3.

squad_notes.2: Hold both drones at base to finish battery swap and stay ready for next tracking.

Hold eastern flank of southeast head near x12 to catch east edge and prevent escape into stale 14,2 and 14,4 blocks.
Stay just SSW of large 9.6,5.4 front to track main head run toward unmapped ground south-west.

squad_notes.2: Hold drone 4 for battery swap while drone 5 sweeps just SSW of the main front to track the downwind head run.
